output.summary: KEP-1314 extends the NodeRestriction admission controller to limit a node's effect on pods: label restrictions to per-namespace whitelisted keys, blocking label/owner changes via pod/status, and restricting mirror pod OwnerReferences to a node reference. Status is implementable at alpha. Per the discussion, the owner-reference and pod/status restrictions were implemented, while the label whitelisting was not and was split out for separate tracking.
output.rationale: Nodes can manipulate pod labels and owner references, letting a compromised node trigger confused-deputy attacks against services and controllers (e.g., matching a service selector or a ReplicaSet). The KEP addresses this by restricting admission for node-originated pod writes. The label whitelisting design was rejected by the maintainer as unsatisfactory, so the label part was never built.
output.outcome_reason: The sources do not record a formal withdrawal or rejection. The status is implementable (alpha). The label restriction part was deferred: the maintainer said it "need[s] to be re-thought out" and that label restrictions would be tracked separately, and a later comment asked whether the label KEP should be withdrawn.

alternatives.option: Per-namespace label whitelisting for mirror pods (the approach in the KEP)
alternatives.why_not: The maintainer said 'I'm not happy with the label whitelisting approach' and 'I'm not satisfied with the whitelist mechanism currently proposed', so it was removed from v1.17 and not implemented.

alternatives.option: Rejecting mirror pods with no owner reference in NodeRestriction
alternatives.why_not: Not rejected; this was adopted. The maintainer asked for it and it was merged, and the sources say 'The OwnerRef restrictions are already merged.'

alternatives.option: Ship the feature gated in v1.17
alternatives.why_not: The maintainer removed the feature-gated parts from v1.17 due to the whitelist concerns and the time crunch, keeping only the non-feature-gated parts.

evidence.quote: I'm not really satisfied with the whitelist mechanism currently proposed on this feature, and with the time crunch & overdue docs, I'm content with removing the feature piece from v1.17.
The OwnerRef restrictions are already merged. The label restrictions have not been implemented, and need to be re-thought out.
Implemented: - OwnerReference requirements for mirror pods - Metadata update restrictions through pod/status updates Not implemented: - Label restrictions on mirror pods
Need to confirm if there is a KEP contains Label restrictions on mirror pods and remove it or move it to "withdraw"
Restrict mirror pod OwnerReferences to only allow a node reference.
